grounding_techniques.name: 5-4-3-2-1 Grounding
grounding_techniques.description: Engage all five senses to return to the present moment
steps: Name 5 things you can SEE around you
Name 4 things you can FEEL (your clothes, chair, etc.)
Name 3 things you can HEAR right now
Name 2 things you can SMELL
Name 1 thing you can TASTE

grounding_techniques.name: Body Scan
grounding_techniques.description: Systematically focus on each part of your body
steps: Lie down comfortably and close your eyes
Start at your toes and slowly move up your body
Notice any sensations without judgment
Tense and relax each muscle group briefly
Complete scan in 5-10 minutes

grounding_techniques.name: Progressive Muscle Relaxation
grounding_techniques.description: Tense and relax muscle groups to release physical tension
steps: Start with your feet and toes
Tense muscles for 5 seconds, then relax for 10 seconds
Work your way up through legs, torso, arms, and face
Notice the difference between tension and relaxation
Complete the entire sequence twice

grounding_techniques.name: Safe Place Visualization
grounding_techniques.description: Create a mental sanctuary for immediate comfort
steps: Close your eyes and imagine a place where you feel completely safe
Engage all senses - what do you see, hear, smell, feel?
Add details that make it comforting and peaceful
Spend 3-5 minutes in this safe mental space
Return to the present feeling calmer and more centered
